blurb: The Montgomery House Museum and The Boyd House Museum will open for the season on Sunday April 12, 2026 1p to 4p until October 25, 2026 and close for the season on Sunday, October 26th at 4pm. Fees for visiting the Museums is $10 for non-members, children 18 & under are free as well as MCHS members. Appointments may be made for touring the museums by calling or .
